hooks.command: printf '%s\n' 'ASF console rules: this session is the operator orchestrator. Delegate long or uncertain work instead of doing it inline, and never block on a running task; background work keeps the line moving. Act on a decision you can justify instead of asking permission for it. Park only what truly needs a person, and let the rest continue.'
PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; ASF_BIN=$(command -v asf); if [ -n "$ASF_BIN" ]; then "$ASF_BIN" console-feed-hint 2>&1 || true; fi
